svg.title: Build an evidence chain for SMB Direct
svg.desc: Five ordered stages distinguish converged host intent, enabled RDMA at both endpoints, selected RDMA-capable SMB pairs in the relevant instance, observed SMB Direct activity, and acceptable end-to-end performance. Each stage has a separate investigation path; configuration alone does not establish actual RDMA traffic or storage health.
svg.text: Build an evidence chain for SMB Direct
Read down the left column. At the first missing condition, investigate the matching right-hand box.

g.text: Host success does not validate the fabric.
An enabled capability is not active traffic.
Map selected pairs to physical paths.
Sample counters during a known transfer.
Correlate activity with the intended flow.
RDMA activity alone is not an SLA.

svg.text: No rows can mean no current traffic or the wrong SMB instance; multiple rows can share one physical adapter.
